concerns.text: The plan proposes a grid search over 12 (τ, k) combos for each of the 500 training clips, running 10 episodes per combo (≈ 60 000 simulation episodes). On a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2‑core CPU, 7 GB RAM) this workload is highly likely to exceed the 6‑hour runtime budget, violating FR‑006 and the Resource‑Constrained Execution principle. The plan must reduce the labeling workload (e.g., fewer clips, fewer episodes per combo, or a smarter hyper‑parameter search) or provide a concrete runtime estimate demonstrating feasibility.
